name: picker_algo_test
description: Headless jsdom test for the element-picker's selector-generation algorithm, embedded as a JS string in ../../lib/koni_dojo_webview.dart's _pickerScript constant. Not Dart because the algorithm needs a live DOM at click time — the one deliberate exception to this project's Dart-only tooling norm, scoped to this single file. Not wired into `task check`; run manually (`npm install && npm test`) after touching the picker-algo:start/end block in koni_dojo_webview.dart.
